title: Execution Contract
description: Every task dispatched by Zeus MUST include a contract. No exceptions. A brief that cannot be contracted is not ready. See Part II §1 of cursor-kit-v2-FINAL.md.

input.description: What this task receives. Must reference specific artifacts, file paths, or data structures — not vague descriptions.

output.description: What this task must produce. Must name specific files, methods, or deliverables with measurable characteristics.

definition_of_done.description: Measurable, binary criteria. Must be verifiable by automated means or explicit inspection. Examples: 'Compiles clean. Test coverage >= 85%. No hardcoded strings.'

validation.description: Exact command or procedure to verify the contract is met. Examples: 'mvn compile && mvn test -pl user-module', 'git secrets --scan'.
